links.outcome: Accuracy replicating published primary outcomes versus reference results, multiagent versus ChatGPT 4o
links.effect: Multiagent framework replicated 53.3% (95% CI, 40.7 to 66.0) of primary outcomes vs ChatGPT 4o 35.0% (95% CI, 22.9 to 47.1); P = .04.
links.quote: The multiagent framework successfully replicated 53.3% (95% CI, 40.7 to 66.0) of primary outcomes, significantly outperforming ChatGPT 4o (35.0% [95% CI, 22.9 to 47.1]; P = .04).

unlisted_practices: Multiagent LLM architecture with specialized planning, data retrieval, cleaning, statistical analysis and review agents to automate data analysis workflows

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a multiagent framework against standard ChatGPT-4o on automating data analysis of medical datasets, testing a novel agent architecture rather than an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
